prompt.project_info: Create a clean studio portrait with warm gradient lighting and modern black corset-style fashion.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional blonde woman with long hair and fair freckled skin, wearing a fitted black corset-style dress with secure coverage, seated comfortably on the floor with one hand behind her and the other touching her hair, calm contemplative off-camera gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: Three-quarter body portrait from a slightly low angle, warm minimalist gradient background, subtle red accent light, relaxed floor pose.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft key light with warm fill and subtle red rim, soft shadows, refined clean editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens at f/2.0, photorealistic skin texture, 768x1152-style portrait, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Studio editorial fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional blonde woman with long hair and fair freckled skin, wearing a fitted black corset-style dress with secure coverage, seated comfortably on the floor with one hand behind her and one touching her hair, calm contemplative gaze to the side, warm gradient studio background, soft key light, warm fill, subtle red rim light, 85mm f/2.0, realistic skin and fabric, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, over-smooth, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed
